method: The listed brown rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Start the 70g dry brown rice first: this is the uncooked weight. Use the water quantity and cooking time on the rice packet; simmer until tender, then drain if the packet method requires it. Keep covered briefly while finishing the pan, then serve immediately.
Drain and rinse canned, ready-cooked kidney beans, then weigh out 100g; raw or dried kidney beans cannot be used in this method. Drain and pat dry the 180g firm tofu, then cut into 2cm cubes.

Warm a non-stick frying pan over a medium-low heat; this recipe does not include frying oil. Add the firm tofu and cook for 8–10 minutes, turning carefully until lightly golden on several sides and hot through. Transfer to a clean plate; keep the pan for the vegetables. Never reuse the plate or utensils that held the raw food without washing them.

Put the 120g chopped tomatoes and 5g smoked paprika into the same frying pan. Stir over a medium-low heat, then cover and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir twice; keep the heat low enough that the tomato liquid does not boil dry.
Add the drained kidney beans, cover and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring halfway, until the beans are hot through.

Return the cooked firm tofu and any collected juices to the pan; fold gently to keep the cubes intact. Heat everything together over a low heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring gently, until steaming hot throughout. Spoon over the freshly cooked rice and serve immediately.
